title: USP16 functions as a novel deubiquitinase of YAP and a therapeutic target of isorhamnetin in gastric cancer.
authors: Li, Yehua; Ren, Siying; Zhang, Qin; Chen, Huanhuan; Ji, Xiang; Shi, Jiale; Yang, Jinbo; Sun, Biqiang; Bai, Fangrui; Huang, Hai; Zhou, Shen'ao
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究USP16去泛素化酶调控YAP蛋白稳定性及胃癌治疗，虽涉及分子对接但核心为蛋白-蛋白互作与泛素化，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gastric cancer remains a major global health burden, and the development of effective therapeutic strategies targeting oncogenic signaling pathways remains an unmet clinical need. Yes-associated protein (YAP), a key effector of the Hippo pathway, is frequently activated in gastric cancer; however, the mechanisms controlling YAP protein stability beyond phosphorylation remain incompletely understood. Deubiquitinating enzymes (DUBs) represent important regulators of protein stability and may provide promising therapeutic targets. PURPOSE: This study aimed to identify novel DUBs regulating YAP stability and elucidate the molecular mechanism underlying the anti-gastric cancer activity of the natural flavonoid isorhamnetin (ISO). METHODS: YAP-interacting proteins were identified by affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry. The molecular mechanisms of USP16-mediated YAP regulation were investigated using biochemical assays, ubiquitination and deubiquitination analyses, transcriptomic profiling, and in vitro and in vivo gastric cancer models. The interaction between ISO and USP16 was evaluated by molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis. RESULTS: We identified USP16 as a previously unrecognized deubiquitinase of YAP. USP16 directly interacted with YAP and removed K48-linked polyubiquitin chains from YAP, primarily at Lys90 and Lys252, thereby preventing proteasomal degradation and enhancing YAP stability. Functionally, USP16 promoted gastric cancer cell proliferation, migration, tumor growth, and metastasis through YAP stabilization. Mechanistically, YAP transcriptionally activated USP16 expression through TEAD-dependent promoter regulation, establishing a positive feedback loop that sustained Hippo/YAP pathway activation. Furthermore, ISO was identified as a direct USP16-binding compound. ISO disrupted the USP16-YAP interaction, impaired USP16-mediated YAP deubiquitination, increased YAP ubiquitination and degradation, and suppressed gastric cancer progression in vitro and in vivo. CONCLUSIONS: This study reveals a previously unidentified USP16-YAP regulatory axis that drives gastric cancer progression and demonstrates USP16 as a therapeutic target of ISO. These findings provide a mechanistic basis for the development of ISO-derived strategies targeting YAP stabilization in gastric cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：胃癌仍然是全球重大健康负担，开发靶向致癌信号通路的有效治疗策略仍是未满足的临床需求。Yes相关蛋白（YAP）是Hippo通路的关键效应因子，在胃癌中频繁被激活；然而，除磷酸化外，控制YAP蛋白稳定性的机制尚未被完全理解。去泛素化酶（DUBs）是蛋白稳定性的重要调控因子，可能提供有前景的治疗靶点。目的：本研究旨在鉴定调控YAP稳定性的新型DUBs，并阐明天然黄酮类化合物异鼠李素（ISO）抗胃癌活性的分子机制。方法：通过亲和纯化结合质谱法鉴定YAP相互作用蛋白。利用生化实验、泛素化与去泛素化分析、转录组学分析以及体外和体内胃癌模型，研究USP16介导的YAP调控的分子机制。通过分子对接和微量热泳动评估ISO与USP16之间的相互作用。结果：我们鉴定USP16为YAP的一种此前未被识别的去泛素化酶。USP16直接与YAP相互作用，并移除YAP上K48连接的多聚泛素链，主要发生在Lys90和Lys252位点，从而阻止蛋白酶体降解并增强YAP稳定性。功能上，USP16通过YAP稳定化促进胃癌细胞增殖、迁移、肿瘤生长和转移。机制上，YAP通过TEAD依赖性启动子调控转录激活USP16表达，建立正反馈环路，维持Hippo/YAP通路激活。此外，ISO被鉴定为一种直接结合USP16的化合物。ISO破坏USP16-YAP相互作用，损害USP16介导的YAP去泛素化，增加YAP泛素化和降解，并在体外和体内抑制胃癌进展。结论：本研究揭示了一个此前未被识别的驱动胃癌进展的USP16-YAP调控轴，并证明USP16是ISO的治疗靶点。这些发现为开发靶向胃癌中YAP稳定性的ISO衍生策略提供了机制基础。
